surveys.name: Single Fire Door Installation
surveys.description: Record and verify a single fire door installation.

questions.label: Is the opening and supporting construction suitable for the specified fire door system?
questions.helpText: Check that the opening and supporting construction are suitable for the specified fire door system.

questions.label: Has the frame certification been checked and verified?
questions.helpText: Check the available frame certification or identification before installation.

questions.label: Is the correct frame installed for the specified fire door system?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the installed frame matches the specified fire door system.

questions.label: Is the frame installed plumb and square?
questions.helpText: Check that the frame is correctly aligned, plumb and square.

questions.label: Is the frame securely fixed using the specified packers, fixings and fixing centres?
questions.helpText: Check that the specified packers and fixings have been used at the required fixing centres.

questions.label: Is the frame-to-wall gap suitable for the specified fire stopping system?
questions.helpText: Check that the gap around the frame is suitable for the specified fire stopping system.

questions.label: Has the specified fire stopping system been installed around the frame?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire stopping materials have been installed around the frame.

questions.label: Are the architraves fitted where required?
questions.helpText: Check that the required architraves are securely fitted and complete the frame installation.

questions.label: Has the door leaf certification been checked and verified?
questions.helpText: Check the available certification or identification for the door leaf.

questions.label: Does the door leaf match the specified fire resistance rating?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the door leaf matches the specified fire resistance rating.

questions.label: Is the door leaf free from damage after installation?
questions.helpText: Check the completed door leaf for visible damage caused during installation.

questions.label: Has the door leaf been installed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation instructions?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the door leaf has been installed in accordance with the applicable manufacturer's instructions.

questions.label: Head Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the top of the door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Hinge-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the hinge side of the door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Lock-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the lock side of the door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Threshold Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the bottom of the door leaf and the finished floor or threshold.

questions.label: Are the correct number and type of fire-rated hinges fitted for the specified fire door system?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the required number and type of fire-rated hinges are fitted.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the hinges been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the hinges for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Has the required intumescent protection been fitted to the hinges?
questions.helpText: Check that the specified intumescent protection has been fitted to the hinges.

questions.label: Are the hinges securely fixed using the specified fixings?
questions.helpText: Check that the hinges are securely fixed using the specified screws or fixings.

questions.label: Have the specified intumescent and smoke seals been installed?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified intumescent and smoke seals have been installed.

questions.label: Are the seals continuous, correctly fitted and free from damage?
questions.helpText: Check that the seals are continuous, secure, correctly positioned and free from damage.

questions.label: Is the specified fire-rated latch / lock fitted, with the required CE / UKCA marking verified?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire-rated latch or lock is fitted and any required conformity marking has been verified.

questions.label: Has the required intumescent protection been fitted to the latch / lock?
questions.helpText: Check that the required intumescent protection has been fitted around the latch or lock.

questions.label: Does the latch / lock operate correctly?
questions.helpText: Operate the latch or lock and check that it moves and engages correctly.

questions.label: Are the specified fire-rated handles securely fitted, with the required CE / UKCA marking verified?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified handles are securely fitted and any required conformity marking has been verified.

questions.label: Do the handles operate correctly?
questions.helpText: Operate the handles and check that they move freely and function correctly.

questions.label: Is the specified fire-rated self-closing device securely fitted, with the required CE / UKCA marking verified?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified self-closing device is securely fitted and any required conformity marking has been verified.

questions.label: Has the self-closing device been correctly adjusted?
questions.helpText: Check that the self-closing device has been adjusted so the door closes correctly.

questions.label: Does the door close fully from all test positions?
questions.helpText: Test the closing action from different open positions and check that the door closes fully.

questions.label: Does the door fully engage the latch when closing, where fitted?
questions.helpText: Check that the door closes fully and engages the latch without assistance where a latch is fitted.

questions.label: Has the specified fire door signage been installed?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire door signage has been fitted.

questions.label: Has the specified fire-rated glazing system been installed?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire-rated glazing system has been installed where glazing is required.

questions.label: Has the glazing certification been checked and verified?
questions.helpText: Check the available certification or identification for the installed fire-rated glazing.

questions.label: Are the glazing beads, fixings and seals installed in accordance with the specified glazing system?
questions.helpText: Check that the glazing beads, fixings and seals match the specified glazing system.

questions.label: Is the glazing free from damage after installation?
questions.helpText: Check the completed glazing for cracks, chips or other visible damage.

questions.label: Does the door open and close freely without binding or obstruction?
questions.helpText: Open and close the door and check that it moves freely without rubbing, sticking or obstruction.

surveys.name: Double Fire Door Installation
surveys.description: Record and verify a double fire door installation.

questions.label: Is the opening and supporting construction suitable for the specified fire door system?
questions.helpText: Check that the opening and supporting construction are suitable for the specified double fire door system.

questions.label: Has the frame certification been checked and verified?
questions.helpText: Check the available frame certification or identification before installation.

questions.label: Is the correct frame installed for the specified fire door system?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the installed frame matches the specified double fire door system.

questions.label: Is the frame installed plumb and square?
questions.helpText: Check that the frame is correctly aligned, plumb and square.

questions.label: Is the frame securely fixed using the specified packers, fixings and fixing centres?
questions.helpText: Check that the specified packers and fixings have been used at the required fixing centres.

questions.label: Is the frame-to-wall gap suitable for the specified fire stopping system?
questions.helpText: Check that the gap around the frame is suitable for the specified fire stopping system.

questions.label: Has the specified fire stopping system been installed around the frame?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire stopping materials have been installed around the frame.

questions.label: Are the architraves fitted where required?
questions.helpText: Check that the required architraves are securely fitted and complete the frame installation.

questions.label: Have the certifications for both door leaves been checked and verified?
questions.helpText: Check the available certification or identification for both door leaves.

questions.label: Do both door leaves match the specified fire resistance rating?
questions.helpText: Confirm that both door leaves match the specified fire resistance rating.

questions.label: Are both door leaves free from damage after installation?
questions.helpText: Check both completed door leaves for visible damage caused during installation.

questions.label: Have both door leaves been installed in accordance with the manufacturer's installation instructions?
questions.helpText: Confirm that both door leaves have been installed in accordance with the applicable manufacturer's instructions.

questions.label: Left Leaf Head Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the top of the left door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Left Leaf Hinge-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the hinge side of the left door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Right Leaf Head Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the top of the right door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Right Leaf Hinge-side Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the hinge side of the right door leaf and the frame.

questions.label: Meeting Stile Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the two door leaves at the meeting stile.

questions.label: Left Leaf Threshold Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the bottom of the left door leaf and the finished floor or threshold.

questions.label: Right Leaf Threshold Gap (mm)
questions.helpText: Measure and record the gap between the bottom of the right door leaf and the finished floor or threshold.

questions.label: Are the correct number and type of fire-rated hinges fitted to both door leaves for the specified fire door system?
questions.helpText: Confirm that both leaves have the required number and type of fire-rated hinges.

questions.label: Has the required CE / UKCA marking on the hinges been verified?
questions.helpText: Check the hinges for the required CE or UKCA conformity marking where applicable.

questions.label: Has the required intumescent protection been fitted to the hinges?
questions.helpText: Check that the required intumescent protection has been fitted to the hinges on both leaves.

questions.label: Are the hinges securely fixed using the specified fixings?
questions.helpText: Check that the hinges on both leaves are securely fixed using the specified screws or fixings.

questions.label: Have the specified intumescent and smoke seals been installed?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified intumescent and smoke seals have been installed throughout the doorset.

questions.label: Are the seals continuous, correctly fitted and free from damage?
questions.helpText: Check that all seals are continuous, secure, correctly positioned and free from damage.

questions.label: Is the specified fire-rated latch / lock fitted, with the required CE / UKCA marking verified?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire-rated latch or lock is fitted and any required conformity marking has been verified.

questions.label: Has the required intumescent protection been fitted to the latch / lock?
questions.helpText: Check that the required intumescent protection has been fitted around the latch or lock.

questions.label: Does the latch / lock operate correctly?
questions.helpText: Operate the latch or lock and check that it moves and engages correctly.

questions.label: Are the specified fire-rated handles securely fitted, with the required CE / UKCA marking verified?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified handles are securely fitted and any required conformity marking has been verified.

questions.label: Do the handles operate correctly?
questions.helpText: Operate the handles and check that they move freely and function correctly.

questions.label: Are the specified fire-rated self-closing devices securely fitted, with the required CE / UKCA marking verified?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the required self-closing devices are securely fitted and any required conformity marking has been verified.

questions.label: Have the self-closing devices been correctly adjusted?
questions.helpText: Check that the self-closing devices are adjusted so both leaves close correctly.

questions.label: Do both door leaves close fully from all test positions?
questions.helpText: Test both leaves from different open positions and check that they close fully.

questions.label: Do both door leaves fully engage the latch or closing position when closing, where fitted?
questions.helpText: Check that both leaves reach their correct closed position without assistance.

questions.label: Do the door leaves close in the correct sequence, where required?
questions.helpText: Where a closing sequence is required, check that the leaves close in the correct order.

questions.label: Has the specified fire door signage been installed?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire door signage has been fitted.

questions.label: Has the specified fire-rated glazing system been installed?
questions.helpText: Confirm that the specified fire-rated glazing system has been installed where glazing is required.

questions.label: Has the glazing certification been checked and verified?
questions.helpText: Check the available certification or identification for the installed fire-rated glazing.

questions.label: Are the glazing beads, fixings and seals installed in accordance with the specified glazing system?
questions.helpText: Check that the glazing beads, fixings and seals match the specified glazing system.

questions.label: Is the glazing free from damage after installation?
questions.helpText: Check all completed glazing for cracks, chips or other visible damage.

questions.label: Do both door leaves open and close freely without binding or obstruction?
questions.helpText: Open and close both leaves and check that neither rubs, sticks or is obstructed.
